newsitem.title: USA: NYC lost 500 jobs in October - city comptroller.
newsitem.headline: NYC lost 500 jobs in October - city comptroller.

text.p: New York City lost 500 jobs in October, the third loss in the last four months, according to seasonally adjusted employment data released by the city comptroller's office.
The private sector lost 400 jobs, while the government sector lost 100 jobs.
Through the first 10 months of 1996, the city had gained a seasonally adjusted 22,900 jobs.

The private sector in October saw growth in the services sector, up 2,400 jobs. Within that sector, social services lost 1,700 jobs, while business services was up 1,300 and movies and amusement up 1,300.
Sector losses included transportation, down 1,300 jobs, wholesale and retail, down 1,300 jobs and finance, insurance and real estate 200.

Government lost 100 jobs in October. Both the state and federal govenment continued to cut employees, but local government, which includes city government and agencies such as the Metropolitan Transportation Authority, added 300 jobs.
